proposals.title: Tighter throttle on Public landing
proposals.summary: PublicController GET landing is @Public with only global 300/min. It resolves the org and may run publicItemsFor findMany for featured/public tiles. Add @Throttle 60/min matching catalog.json / CSW list class.
proposals.rationale: Deferred from R15 after STAC collections / Styles / Records-item / Aardvark. Anonymous front door without a Nest budget; scrape-friendly org landing.
proposals.risk: Hot public landings under shared NATs may hit 60/min. Prefer 60; keep response shape. CHANGELOG Security + api.md rate note; skip What's new.
proposals.ethosFit: Public portal front door with honest DoS budget. Self-hosted hardening.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add @Throttle 60/min on GET landing; CHANGELOG Security + api.md; skip What's new.

proposals.title: Tighter throttle on Public single-item GET
proposals.summary: PublicController GET items/:id is @Public with only global 300/min. Anonymous viewers compose map + each layer + basemap through this path. Add @Throttle 60/min matching Records-item / OGC Features featureId / STAC item.
proposals.rationale: Deferred from R15. Closes the anon item lookup budget gap so id sweeps cannot lean on the global 300/min alone.
proposals.risk: A public viewer with many layers opens several item GETs at once; 60/min per IP still fits normal maps. Prefer 60; keep UUID gate and payload shape. CHANGELOG Security + api.md; skip What's new.
proposals.ethosFit: Honest Public item read budget. No seat pricing.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add @Throttle 60/min on GET items/:id; CHANGELOG Security + api.md; skip What's new.

proposals.title: Tighter throttle on Public basemap items list

proposals.risk: Clients that refresh basemap galleries often may hit 60/min. Prefer 60; keep type=basemap gate, paging, and empty-list refusal for other types. CHANGELOG Security + api.md; skip What's new.
proposals.ethosFit: Public basemap catalogue with DoS budget. Prefer MapLibre / open tile shapes.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add @Throttle 60/min on GET items basemap list; CHANGELOG Security + api.md; skip What's new.

proposals.title: Tighter throttle on Public OSM presets catalog
proposals.summary: PublicController GET osm/presets is @Public with only global 300/min. Serves the vendored iD preset catalog (long-cached 24h). Add @Throttle 60/min so uncached scrapers cannot lean on the global bucket alone.
proposals.rationale: Deferred from R15. Open-data catalog surface; browser force-cache already coalesces recipe opens, Nest budget still needed for anonymous hammering.
proposals.risk: Cold clients after deploy may burst once; 60/min is enough. Keep Cache-Control immutable. CHANGELOG Security + short api.md / OSM note; skip What's new.
proposals.ethosFit: Open OSM preset catalog with honest rate limits. Prefer OGC / open-data shapes.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add @Throttle 60/min on GET osm/presets; CHANGELOG Security + api.md; skip What's new.

proposals.title: Tighter throttle on Public thumbnail.svg
